div.div: مَسْلُوسٌ Bereft of reason, or intellect; (S, M;) and [of bulk] of body, (M, TA,) as some say; but accord. to the T, one says رَجُلٌ مَسْلُوسٌ in respect of his reason, or intellect, but مَهْلُوسٌ in respect of his body: (TA:) possessed, or insane. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
